Taskkill command:
Open a Command Prompt and type the following command:
taskkill /im python.exe
Press Enter to run the command. The taskkill command will terminate all processes with the name python.exe.
Kill command:
Open a terminal and type the following command:
kill -9 <process_id>
Replace <process_id> with the ID of the Python process that you want to terminate. You can find the process ID by typing the following command:
ps -ef | grep python
The ps command lists all running processes, and the grep command searches for the string python in the process list. The output shows the process ID and the command that started the process.
For example, if the output shows the following line:
root 12345 0.0 0.0 1044 312 Dec 16? 00:00:00 python
Then you can use the following command to terminate the Python process:
kill -9 12345
Note: Be careful when using the kill command. If you terminate the wrong process, it could cause your system to become unstable.
